operator_stimulus: Record all discussed repeat-realization and Aspect SCC leads in the Hodge conjecture net. Explore compatible partial realizations with no joint algebraic filler; do not presume Hodge false.

semantics.edges: Research prerequisites, not proved implications or imported SCC evidence.
semantics.fixed_target: Inherit X,p,alpha unchanged from base scope; no new candidate is selected.
semantics.blocked: A source bridge is missing; not an executable waiting task.
semantics.rejected_at_scope: Only the named shortcut is rejected, not Hodge or all enriched realization methods.
semantics.acceptance: Independent source-defined rational class invariant, universal necessity for all rational algebraic cycle combinations, choice independence and nonzero fixed-alpha detection.

leads.hypothesis: Source-derived boundary data of alpha may match on every proper face but admit no algebraic joint filler.
leads.missing: An independently defined algebraic boundary system, matching map and alpha boundary; no identification of arity with p.
leads.test: Every actual cycle supplies a filler; prove the alpha fiber empty independent of representatives.
leads.falsifier: An alpha filler or an algebraic control excluded by the proposed matching condition.

leads.hypothesis: The all-proper-projections-surjective mechanism can occur with a nonzero rational joint defect.
leads.missing: Source-derived rational constraint; the illustrative hyperplane sum(x_i)=0 in Q^n is not an algebraic-cycle invariant.
leads.test: Bind a rational target and joint constraint to X; test proper restrictions and nonzero rational defect separately.
leads.falsifier: Defect is torsion-only, arbitrary, or vanishes on alpha.

leads.hypothesis: Individual realizations may fail to admit jointly coherent comparison maps.
leads.missing: Source-derived comparisons with an obstruction surviving every allowed change, not an imposed bad compositor.
leads.test: Separate existence of representatives from coherence; prove no allowed comparison choice removes the rational obstruction.
leads.falsifier: A coherent alternative exists; the SCC fixture itself has a coherent zero twist.

leads.hypothesis: Legitimate changes of presentation must preserve emptiness of the realization fiber.
leads.missing: Natural comparison maps for the proposed Hodge boundary system.
leads.test: Construct conjugate matching maps and fiber equivalences; mutate naturality and invertibility independently.
leads.falsifier: An allowed re-presentation changes an empty fiber to a nonempty fiber.

leads.hypothesis: A cycle-library obstruction is relevant only with coverage of all rational algebraic cycles.
leads.missing: Universal cycle-to-boundary necessity theorem, including singular supports and rational signed combinations.
leads.test: Prove source completeness rather than extrapolate from divisors or a finite library.
leads.falsifier: A legitimate algebraic cycle omitted or rejected by the library.

leads.hypothesis: Forward realization, backward attachment, route compatibility and readout descent must be verified separately unless a source theorem relates them.
leads.missing: Typed instantiation of the four gates on the proposed Hodge system.
leads.test: Retain single-gate failure controls; never infer descent from internal coherence alone.
leads.falsifier: A claimed implication is contradicted by a single-gate failure in its declared sector.

leads.hypothesis: Attachment correspondences may fail to have a universal representing object despite individual lifts.
leads.missing: A Hodge-specific lift correspondence and proof that representability, rather than mere nonemptiness, is necessary for algebraicity.
leads.test: Distinguish empty, branching and symmetry-rich lift fibers; nonrepresentability alone is not Hodge failure.
leads.falsifier: An algebraic class has lifts but no universal chosen representative.

leads.hypothesis: Completing local realization data may leave a global compatibility obstruction unchanged.
leads.missing: An algebraic completion system and same-class comparison across refinements; no physical Bell premise transfers.
leads.test: Hold the source/class fixed while adding legitimate local data and track one invariant global defect.
leads.falsifier: A licensed completion fills the purportedly impossible boundary.

leads.hypothesis: A retained realization may preserve a visible class while losing a capability needed for a second use.
leads.missing: A source-derived enriched partial operation, not an invented resource flag.
leads.test: Define c,r and compare crc with c including witnesses; show necessity for every algebraic class and failure for every alpha lift.
leads.falsifier: Only a particular algorithm fails, or a known algebraic cycle violates the stronger requirement.

leads.hypothesis: Ordinary duality or a cycle-class section yields a third-pass failure.
leads.missing: Not applicable to the rejected total-map claim.
leads.test: PD is invertible; cr=id implies crc=c. Exact recovery of every Chow representative fails even for algebraic degree-zero divisors.
leads.falsifier: An error in the typed recovery proof; richer partial operations are outside this rejection.

leads.hypothesis: Full derived duality of cycle structure sheaves fails on the third pass in higher codimension.
leads.missing: Not applicable to perfect biduality; another operation would be a distinct lead.
leads.test: Perfect biduality and its triangle close; rational topological K-lifts also admit repeated duality.
leads.falsifier: A failure of the stated perfectness/duality hypotheses; truncation is not full derived duality.

leads.hypothesis: Centrality forces cycle-object symmetry or positive-degree rational C4 cohomology detects alpha.
leads.missing: Fixed-X all-cycle CLASS invariance remains unproved and is not rejected here.
leads.test: Non-equivariant algebraic complete intersections and rational finite-group contraction reject these scoped shortcuts.
leads.falsifier: A defect in those arguments; positive total equivariant degree is outside the vanishing claim.

leads.hypothesis: Compatibility and admissibility are distinct: coherent observations need not be positive.
leads.missing: No Hodge-specific admissibility cone or all-cycle bridge is supplied.
leads.test: Use as a design warning, not an RH proof transfer or Hodge positivity assumption.
leads.falsifier: A proposed transfer lacks source identity or completion control.

leads.hypothesis: Shared-face local continuation can preserve identities yet fail a global embedding requirement.
leads.missing: No bridge identifies tetrahedral faces, M/C roles or realization coordinates with complex algebraic codimension.
leads.test: Retain the reported overlap and identity guards as analogies only; do not infer physical particle or Hodge conclusions.
leads.falsifier: An asserted bridge fails typed source or operation comparison.

conjectures.statement: The fixed Hodge realization problem admits a source-derived two-cotower presentation with a marked central comparison, represented by a coherent diagram on the eight-nodes-per-edge tetrahedral lattice; testing its mixed interchanges and higher fillers can expose a rational class-level obstruction to algebraic realization.
conjectures.operator_stimulus: Take the RH eight-lattice coherence pyramid; place Hodge at its barycenter, identify the two cotowers forming the tetrahedron, then test all applicable coherences.
conjectures.quantifiers: Existence of two independently sourced Hodge cotowers, a common target and source-derived cross-comparisons on the fixed X,p,alpha; an obstruction must exclude all rational algebraic representatives, not one diagram presentation.
conjectures.source_result: The geometric RH prior models eight nodes per edge by esd_7(Delta^3), with 120 vertices and 343 tetrahedra. A separate RH two-tower prior distinguishes forward composition and source coherence, requiring mixed interchange; it warns that quadratic observation can erase a central sign. These are related priors, not a proved identification with the requested cotowers.

candidate_roles.second: Algebraic source realization and its retained witnesses
candidate_roles.status: Provisional role assignment only: neither tower, direction, filtration, nor comparison functor has been constructed; no algebraic lift of alpha is assumed.

conjectures.central_mark: Hodge is provisionally the central realization question, not an existing algebraic object. The geometric barycenter has normalized coordinates (1/4,1/4,1/4,1/4); it is not a vertex of the degree-seven integer lattice. A central object requires a declared cone, refinement or other typed attachment, not silent relabeling.
coherence_tests: Define both cotower directions, objects and source/target types.
Construct their elementary maps independently of the desired obstruction.
Verify face comparisons and compatibility on shared lattice boundaries.
Test mixed interchange between composition and source realization, including signs and attachments.
Specify the categorical target before deciding which higher fillers are forced and which are independent.
Test readout descent, existence reflection and stability under allowed refinement.
Do not promote finite lattice coherence to an unbounded completion theorem.
conjectures.missing: Actual two Hodge cotowers, their central attachment and the source-derived mixed comparison cells; no canonical tower count follows from the tetrahedral drawing.
conjectures.acceptance: Construct one common typed diagram, prove all-cycle necessity for its required fillers, and find a nonremovable rational defect on alpha, independent of presentation. A coherent diagram without a defect validates only that realization model.
conjectures.falsifier: The proposed cotowers do not have common interfaces, their discrepancy is removable by legitimate sign normalization, the alleged failure also rejects an algebraic control, or the alpha diagram fills. Each rejects the proposed binding or detector, not every possible two-cotower formulation.
conjectures.next_test: Identify the two source-derived cotowers and the central attachment; then test the mixed comparison before attempting 343 cell checks.
guards: Eight nodes per edge is not eight total vertices or eight coherence axioms.
A strict ordinary-category nerve can force higher coherence once composition is fixed; its tetrahedra are not independent obstruction tests.
A central sign or missing filler must survive rational class descent to matter for Hodge.
Neither RH results nor a tetrahedral picture establish a Hodge obstruction.

conjectures.statement: There exists a source-derived Hodge realization interface whose compressed readout identifies an absent configuration with an admitted configuration having an empty realization fiber, and restoring the domain data yields a rational class-level obstruction detecting the fixed alpha and vanishing on every algebraic cycle class.
conjectures.quantifiers: Existence of an independently defined interface on the fixed X,p; necessity for every rational algebraic cycle combination; exclusion of every algebraic representative of alpha.
conjectures.source_result: Aspect distinguishes an absent configuration, an admitted empty constraint object and an admitted object with zero readout; this is not a Hodge-specific result.
conjectures.missing: The actual Hodge configuration domain, compression map, independently defined realization constraints and rational detector.
conjectures.acceptance: Exhibit the source maps, prove domain erasure, construct a choice-independent rational obstruction, prove universal algebraic necessity and nonzero alpha detection.
conjectures.falsifier: For a proposed binding, the readout reflects the relevant existence distinctions, the defect disappears under legitimate presentation change, or an algebraic control is excluded. This rejects that binding, not the unrestricted existential claim.
conjectures.next_test: Identify a concrete source map and compare domain membership separately from fiber emptiness; do not replace undefined by zero.
guards: No assertion that classical Hodge itself makes the conflation.
The original recalled Hodge statement and author have not been located.

conjectures.statement: There exists a source-derived realization system for the fixed Hodge problem in which unary and binary data agree for fillable and nonfillable higher boundaries, while a rational higher matching obstruction separates alpha from every algebraic cycle class.
conjectures.quantifiers: Existence of a source-bound system and higher boundary for alpha; all algebraic cycles must supply admissible fillers, regardless of representative.
conjectures.source_result: Hollow and filled simplices have the same lower incidence; parity fixtures have compatible proper-face data with nonfillable full boundaries. Neither is yet a Hodge interface.
conjectures.missing: Actual Hodge probe maps and a rational higher constraint not defined by the unknown algebraic-cycle image.
conjectures.acceptance: Construct indistinguishable lower readouts, a nonfillable alpha boundary and a universal algebraic filler theorem; prove the defect survives rationalization and allowed refinements.
conjectures.falsifier: The proposed source has a theorem reconstructing all higher fillers from lower data, alpha has a filler, or the candidate defect is torsion-only. Candidate failure does not rule out every possible system.
conjectures.next_test: Bind a lower-probe restriction functor and test whether it reflects existence of higher fillers before choosing a numerical defect.
guards: Binary probe arity is not polynomial degree two without a separate bridge.
Simplex dimension is not complex algebraic codimension.

conjectures.statement: There exists a source-derived Hodge realization readout q(v)=norm(Bv)^2 with a nonzero task-relevant kernel invisible to q, and a retained source comparison detecting that lost information yields a rational class-level obstruction annihilating all algebraic cycle classes but detecting alpha.
conjectures.quantifiers: Existence of a typed source carrier, B and positive norm with a nonzero kernel witness; universal algebraic necessity and exclusion of every alpha representative remain separate requirements.
conjectures.source_result: A selected scalar can vanish while complementary and incidence ports remain nonzero. For a positive norm q(v)=0 means Bv=0, not v=0 unless B is injective.
conjectures.missing: The full Hodge norm has now been computed and has no nonzero kernel. The divisor-only reader has kernel W, but its universal annihilation on algebraic classes is unproved. A restricted-reader necessity theorem or distinct source-bound observer is required; witness sensitivity must descend to classes.
conjectures.acceptance: Derive B and the positive pairing, exhibit a nonzero kernel witness and a licensed distinguishing continuation, then establish rational descent, universal annihilation and nonzero alpha detection.
conjectures.falsifier: B is faithful on the relevant source, the dark direction is irrelevant gauge, or the proposed detector only distinguishes homologically equivalent algebraic cycles. This rejects the particular binding.
conjectures.next_test: Use the computed divisor-reader kernel W to test whether any proposed all-algebraic necessity argument assumes divisor-probe completeness; compare against the existing projector equivalence and known algebraic controls. Do not repeat the full-norm computation or treat its phase blindness as a dark input.
guards: Noninjectivity of cl does not disprove its surjectivity.
Indefinite quadratic forms may have nonzero isotropic vectors without a kernel; the positive-norm hypothesis is essential.
Zero readout, empty fiber and absent configuration are distinct.

tested_bindings.disposition: The operator-selected Gauss test identifies the old Weil reader with a canonical-form cross pairing. Its fixed-source Gram matrix yields the sharper effective bound b^2+c^2 <=27 a^2/4, but the permitted cone still spans the whole Hodge space. Plucker equations do not force cross-minor vanishing; an actual algebraic product-fiber graph has reader(0,1/4). No global Gauss-image restriction or universal orthogonality theorem is obtained. The bounded branch stops rather than spawning another control chain.
tested_bindings.next_construction: None from this bounded test. Reopening requires a separately justified global-geometric restriction; the queued polystable audit was not executed.

tested_bindings.disposition: The explicit polynomial in psi2 selects degree3 at all seven weights. With b=P3((1-H^-1)^3), the Euler functional chi(v b)/2160 subtracts the divisor cube and gives an idempotent rational K-normalization of the supplied Weil readout. Actual Koszul and unipotent controls are killed exactly in K0_Q; terminal syzygies retain the normalized input. Zero Betti readout is not asserted to mean zero Chow class, and rank-zero virtual output is not a positive-rank bundle.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Audit actual polystable bundle realization under a discriminant equality using Hermitian-Einstein/Chern-Weil theory, without imposing those hypotheses on virtual classes or all cycles.

tested_bindings.disposition: Six ample-twist presentations of an arbitrary codimension-three cycle sheaf end in a locally free kernel K6, not necessarily a bundle in the bounded generated class. The exact K-relation gives ch3(K6)=[Z]+S3 e^3/6 and c3 Weil readout twice that of Z. The true complete-intersection Koszul sequence instead has a line terminal bundle at step3 with negative sign. This identifies the unconstrained source rather than proving universal annihilation or constructing a missing Weil cycle.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Build a rational Adams degree-three selector and divisor subtraction on supplied K-classes, retaining virtual and Chow/cohomology distinctions.

tested_bindings.disposition: The imported simple-semihomogeneous isogeny-splitting theorem and injective rational Chow pullback give ch(F)=r exp(c1(F)/r). The fixed Picard certificate then places cohomological Chern characters in Q[E]. Only sums, extensions with generated endpoints, tensor products and duals are closed explicitly. The generated degree-three readouts vanish, but the single-exponential formula need not survive sums, and Picard rank one is not Chow rank one. No fresh primary-text audit or completeness for all bundles is claimed.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Track an arbitrary cycle sheaf through ample-twist presentations and its unconstrained terminal locally free syzygy, without repackaging the original gate as a new obstruction.

tested_bindings.disposition: The regular-nilpotent commuting arc algebraizes over C[[t]] by proper formal existence. More strongly, finite Cech exponentials define a bundle over X times A1 and vanishing lifts the defining section algebraically; a neighborhood of zero gives a nonconstant smooth embedded family. Its unipotent filtration proves the exact Chow equality [Z_t]=k^3 c1(H)^3 and zero Weil readout. The zero-locus c3 differs from bundle ch3 by the required factor2.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Audit simple semihomogeneous bundle Chern characters and explicitly justified closure operations on the unchanged Picard-rank-one source.

tested_bindings.disposition: The strict invariant-Dolbeault quasi-isomorphism gives the full commuting-six-matrix bundle model. Equivariant section lifting and a section-frame gauge slice leave 3h0(L)-9 smooth variables with no residual conjugation quotient. The obstruction-compatible zero-locus map is an equivalence over small extensions by Koszul vanishing. Hence the completed Hilbert germ is the commuting-matrix formal scheme times that smooth factor, with tangent dimension3h0(L)+45 and120 independent quadratic equations; no regular-sequence dimension subtraction is licensed.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Algebraize a regular-nilpotent commuting arc over C[[t]] and compute its unchanged divisor-cube class and Weil-plane readout.

tested_bindings.disposition: The invariant bundle deformation E12 u+E21 v has nonzero quadratic cohomology obstruction diag(1,-1,0) u wedge v and zero trace. H1(E)=0 lifts the defining section at first order. The pair-to-zero-locus Cech obstruction comparison, with Koszul acyclicity, transfers this to a genuinely obstructed embedded Hilbert tangent direction. Such values linearly span the dimension120 semiregularity kernel, without claiming that every vector is a single value. The ambient X stays fixed and other cycle lifts still exist.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Verify the invariant-Dolbeault formal model and retain sections and gauge before identifying the full control deformation problem with commuting matrices.

tested_bindings.disposition: Koszul identifies H1(N) with End(C3) tensor H2(O_X). The Koszul-Atiyah transgression specializes semiregularity to l^2 times trace, yielding rank15 and kernel120 by Lefschetz. Actual ambient first-order obstruction values are scalar matrices and intersect that kernel trivially; polarized directions lift despite noninjective semiregularity. No calculation is assigned to unknown Weil-cycle representatives.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Construct a noncommuting matrix-valued bundle deformation with nonzero trace-invisible quadratic obstruction, then separately audit transfer to embedded zero-locus deformation.

tested_bindings.disposition: For a supplied smooth embedding, restriction and normal projection send Kodaira-Spencer classes to the actual H1(N) obstruction; semiregularity sends this to the Hodge derivative in H4(Omega2). Vanishing of that image alone does not prove lifting. A high-degree complete intersection actually lifts by extending relative ample sections even though its normal H1 has dimension135; the semiregularity target has dimension225. No smooth representative or obstruction computation for alpha is assumed.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Compute the complete-intersection semiregularity map using the defining-section space, Koszul identification and ambient contraction, rather than guessing its rank from dimensions.

tested_bindings.disposition: Chow localization extends the dense-open relative classes over the same smooth control base. Refined fiber pullback and flat local-system continuation realize R,I in every control fiber without assuming flat closures. In contrast, pushing the dimension7 cycle into a dimension15 full-family total space gives codimension8, whose refined sixfold-fiber target is zero; it is not a transverse codimension3 extension.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Type the embedded first-order obstruction and its Hodge/semiregularity image, with a high-degree complete-intersection positive lifting control.

tested_bindings.disposition: After finite determinant-monodromy trivialization, pointwise algebraicity and countably many proper signed Hilbert parameter spaces force a component carrying both R and I to dominate the product-control base. A generic finite multisection becomes finite etale on a dense open; tracing universal cycles with factors 1/(d m_R) and 1/(d m_I) gives actual relative rational Chow classes there. This is nonconstructive relative existence over the dimension4 control base, not dominance over full dimension9 moduli or a witness at the fixed simple point.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Extend by Chow localization within the same control base and distinguish refined specialization from an attempted transverse extension into full Weil moduli.

tested_bindings.disposition: The original polynomial-period argument remains valid for rational Hodge equations and Picard rank, but does not establish algebraic-moduli genericity or a dominant relative cycle component. The exact analytic-coordinate hostile z0=log(2)/2^20, u(z)=exp(2^20 z) maps a transcendental coordinate to an algebraic point. The audit types the separate period, moduli and Hilbert/Chow interfaces and the missing dominance hypothesis; product-control dimensions do not supply it on the full base.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Use pointwise algebraicity and countable cycle parameters to construct a dominant component and normalized relative trace over the product control locus only.

tested_bindings.disposition: Rational Neron-Severi rank is isogeny invariant, while a nontrivial abelian product has at least two independent factor polarizations. The unchanged Picard-rank-one X is therefore simple by Poincare reducibility, excluding product/isogeny or rational re-marking transport of the controls. Nonlinear complete-intersection threefolds still exist on X and have Albanese dimension6; arbitrary algebraic supports and correspondences remain unexcluded.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Audit period-coordinate independence versus algebraic-moduli genericity and relative cycle spreading before claiming deformation from the supplied controls.

tested_bindings.disposition: Two varying threefold factors of signatures(2,1),(1,2) admit elliptic correspondences on fourfolds of Hermitian determinants1 and3, using opposite CM embeddings and the audited all-discriminants theorem. Their codimension-two products pushed along C give codimension-three cycles with classes R and I, with exact signs. This covers a four-complex-dimensional decomposable locus of the nonsplit sixfold family, not the original selected period.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Test whether the original Picard-rank-one sixfold could acquire such a product decomposition up to isogeny or rational re-marking.

tested_bindings.disposition: Using the audited algebraic Gamma, its signed CM transform, the holomorphic conjugate elliptic projection and actual inactive divisors gives Chow expressions with classes K1,K2,R,I. Exact odd-degree factor-order signs are verified. Thus the previously non-divisor-generated joint-control classes are algebraic by imported-theorem-backed operations; no explicit equations, relative family or original fixed-alpha witness is claimed.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Allow both complementary-signature threefold factors to vary and replace the fixed elliptic projection by composition of two algebraic correspondences.

tested_bindings.disposition: Freshly read primary Corollary1.6.1 in Markman2502.03415v2, PDF9, covers all abelian fourfolds and explicitly handles threefold-times-elliptic products; the retained survey Theorem1.2 corroborates Weil-class coverage. Two PDFs/pages were hash-verified. Accepting the imported theorem gives algebraic representatives of gamma and both control Weil components, not explicit equations or a result for the nonsplit sixfold.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Pull back the theorem-backed correspondence and its CM transform and multiply the inactive divisor classes to realize K1,K2 on the joint control.

tested_bindings.disposition: The active determinant has types(2,1),(1,2), and its Tate twist is a CM elliptic H1 with the conjugate K embedding. The explicit class gamma=f external p-e external q is type(2,2) and induces e to p, f to q. Its ambient C times A is a split Weil fourfold with signature(2,2), Hermitian determinant1 and an explicit isotropic two-plane; gamma is minus the imaginary determinant component. No algebraic correspondence is inferred from the Hodge isomorphism alone.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Audit exact split Weil-fourfold algebraicity theorem coverage, including the decomposable/special-fiber hypotheses, for this actual control.

tested_bindings.disposition: At a specified small algebraically independent real pair P11=s,P12=t, rank56 constraints plus ten globally invariant divisor classes prove Picard rank10. All triple divisor products span20 dimensions of even active degree. K1,K2 remain Hodge but have active degree3; augmenting by them gives rank22. Thus no nonzero combination is divisor-generated at this control fiber. Non-divisor cycles and the original fixed endpoint remain unresolved.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Identify the rank-two active determinant Hodge structure and its possible codimension-two elliptic-to-threefold correspondence source without assuming algebraicity.

tested_bindings.disposition: All four original degree-six summands fail the first-order Hodge condition, with rank2 and kernel spanned by v3-v0 and v1+v2. The kernel survives exactly along the path and has replacement divisor witnesses from native pairs (1,5),(2,4),(3,6). Thus R remains pointwise algebraic along this off-diagonal path despite failure of the original summands; no relative cycle family or fixed-endpoint witness is inferred.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Compute the rational divisor space and product span in the joint P11=s,P12=t family, where separate axis witnesses need not be compatible.

tested_bindings.disposition: All six fixed divisor factors are Hodge exactly on the diagonal positive-plane chart locus, a product of three disks of complex dimension3. The full real tangent map has rank12 and diagonal kernel dimension6. The proof excludes nonlinear off-diagonal solutions using decomposable-form stabilizers, while the diagonal product-of-surfaces family supplies actual divisor witnesses. This is not the all-cycle realization locus.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Differentiate the actual degree-six product summands of R and distinguish their transport obstruction from cancellation in the total class.

tested_bindings.disposition: The legitimate chart path P_(1,2)=t has positive Gram matrix for |t|<1. Its Hodge derivative has rank4 on the six retained divisor factors, obstructing r1,s1,r2,s2, while R and I remain type(3,3) exactly. Thus flat determinant type does not transport the chosen algebraic divisor witness; no exclusion of other cycle witnesses is inferred.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Compute the simultaneous full-chart Hodge locus of all six fixed divisor factors and test the diagonal positive subfamily.

tested_bindings.disposition: The actual reader F(f)=(-1/32)(integral f*R,integral f*I) covers every algebraic generator via resolution and equals the Weil coordinates of its class. Resolution, graph and envelope comparisons preserve this reader with explicitly different degree normalizations for graph pairings and two pullbacks. The complete route is merged with the existing universal projector-annihilation gate; source completeness does not prove vanishing. Broad existential conjectures remain open.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Do not re-extend the same equivalent diagram. Independently test first-order deformation of the actual product-fiber divisor witnesses against preservation of the Weil determinant class.

tested_bindings.disposition: The computed Lefschetz-sector pushforward proves g*alpha is primitive. Its trace is d alpha and positive norm32d. Refined Chow pullback between smooth varieties and proper pushforward show alpha is algebraic iff g*alpha is algebraic, without finite-flat assumptions. Auxiliary realization transports rather than solves the unknown cycle-image gate.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Compose the all-generator proper-map and auxiliary interfaces into a source-complete Weil reader, separating descent/coverage from universal annihilation.

tested_bindings.disposition: Any supplied smooth proper-map source embeds by its graph in a smooth auxiliary sixfold cut out by N positive hypersurfaces in X times P^N. Normal rank failure has codimension4, exceeding the graph dimension3. Projection has degree b^N, and exact projective-bundle integration gives g_*(ell H4(M))=E H4(X), with g_*[Gamma]=f_*(1_Y). No primitive center class is assumed zero.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Compute the fixed candidate pullback, primitivity, norm and rational Chow pull-push to assess whether the auxiliary construction changes algebraicity.

tested_bindings.disposition: Every singular threefold cycle generator is the degree-one proper pushforward of a smooth projective resolution. This is not an embedding into X. A fixed-X nodal complete intersection resolves in Bl_p X with class k^3 pi*(E^3)-2e^3; the nonzero exceptional H6 class is killed by pushforward. All cycle images are spanned by f_*(1_Y), but their primitive parts remain unknown.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Embed the proper-map source by its graph in X times projective space and test a smooth auxiliary sixfold plus its polarization pushforward.

tested_bindings.disposition: For any supplied smooth connected algebraic threefold center, generic high-degree envelopes are nodal and b2(Z) cancels between the two blowup comparisons. K_D remains rank1, but psi(r_Z) is the actual primitive center class, not automatically zero. The full support image is E cup H4(X) plus Q cl(Z). Singular centers are not covered by embedded smoothability.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Type resolution and proper pushforward for singular cycle generators, with a nodal complete-intersection control.

tested_bindings.disposition: The ambient blowup and ample strict transform have b4=562. Removing codimension-three P2 node fibers preserves H4; the codimension-two smooth-locus blowup subtracts b2(Z)=66, giving b4(U)=496 and dim K_D=1. The known r_Z spans K_D and psi is zero, so the entire support image is E cup H4(X), excluding alpha for this generic envelope family only.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Repeat with an arbitrary supplied smooth center and retain its actual primitive cycle class instead of assuming a polarization multiple.

tested_bindings.disposition: The embedded pair is locally sum x_i y_i=0 with Z:y=0. A ruling plane has nonzero link class modulo a+b; its primitive normalization has twice the residue. The actual global r_Z is nonzero but gamma(r_Z)=psi(r_Z)=0. Subtracting a rational ambient complete intersection produces an algebraic cycle with nonzero support class and zero ambient Chow class.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Compute the full residue rank for this family using the blowup and its exceptional node fibers.

tested_bindings.disposition: The five-dimensional node link is the unit tangent sphere bundle of S5, with rational cohomology in degrees0,4,5,9. Local terms enter degrees5,6,10. Extra H4 of the smooth divisor locus is ker(gamma:Q^N->H5(D)); its ambient primitive support image is a second map psi, not the raw node count. Actual ranks of gamma and psi remain unknown.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Compute the actual known algebraic threefold residue using the local ruling plane, and compare its nonzero local terms with its ambient polarization class.

tested_bindings.disposition: For sufficiently large m the ideal/conormal sequence surjects on normal sections. Generic transversality gives reduced zeros, Bertini gives smoothness off the known algebraic Z, and the local Hessian has determinant -det(A)^2. Thus a general containing divisor has exactly 2160 k^3(m-k)^3 ordinary double points. This count occurs for an already algebraic support and is not a Hodge obstruction.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Compute the nodal link and local-to-global localization sequence before treating node contributions as independent support classes.

tested_bindings.disposition: Weak Lefschetz and Gysin identify the entire smooth ample divisor support image with E cup H4(X); primitive alpha is outside. This is not all-support exclusion: the known algebraic Z=CI(kE,kE,kE) forces every containing divisor of class mE, m>k, to be singular, by the normal derivative top Chern number 2160 k^3(m-k)^3. Z nevertheless has an explicit smooth envelope at m=k.
tested_bindings.next_construction: Analyze generic normal derivative transversality and the local Hessian to calibrate singular-envelope counts on this known algebraic control.

tested_bindings.disposition: Support duality identifies H_Z^6 with top Borel-Moore homology, freely generated by three-dimensional irreducible components even for singular/reducible Z.
